CompareImageFaces.description_en: Compares the similarity between two faces by calling the CompareImageFaces operation
CompareImageFaces.description_zh: 调用CompareImageFaces接口比较两个人脸的相似度

ConvertOfficeFormat.description_en: Converts a document (such as an Office document) to a specified format by using a synchronous request and returns the number of pages that are converted
ConvertOfficeFormat.description_zh: 采用同步请求方式进行文档（例如Office文档）格式的转换，执行完毕返回转换成功的页数

CreateGrabFrameTask.description_en: Calls the CreateGrabFrameTask operation to create a video frame capture task. A TaskId is returned after the task is complete
CreateGrabFrameTask.description_zh: 调用CreateGrabFrameTask接口创建一个视频截帧任务，执行完成后返回TaskId

CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob.description_en: Merges two face groups in a media set by calling the CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob operation
CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob.description_zh: 调用CreateMergeFaceGroupsJob接口合并媒体集中的两个人脸分组

CreateOfficeConversionTask.description_en: Converts a document (such as an Office document) asynchronously and returns a TaskId after the conversion is complete
CreateOfficeConversionTask.description_zh: 采用异步请求方式进行文档（例如Office文档）格式的转换，执行完成后返回TaskId

CreateSet.description_en: Creates a media set by calling the CreateSet operation

CreateVideoCompressTask.description_en: Calls the CreateVideoCompressTask operation to create a video compression and storage task. After the task is complete, a TaskId is returned
CreateVideoCompressTask.description_zh: 调用CreateVideoCompressTask接口创建一个视频压缩存储任务，执行完成后返回TaskId

DecodeBlindWatermark.description_en: Parses a blind watermark added by Intelligent Media Management (IMM)

DeleteImage.description_en: Deletes a specified image from a media set
DeleteImage.description_zh: 删除媒体集中指定的图片

DeleteOfficeConversionTask.description_en: Deletes an asynchronous document format conversion task by calling the DeleteOfficeConversionTask operation
DeleteOfficeConversionTask.description_zh: 调用DeleteOfficeConversionTask接口删除异步文档格式转换任务

DeleteProject.description_en: Calls the DeleteProject operation to delete a project
DeleteProject.description_zh: 调用DeleteProject接口删除一个项目

DeleteSet.description_en: Calls the DeleteSet operation to delete a media set

DeleteVideo.description_en: Deletes the information of a video from a media set
DeleteVideo.description_zh: 调用DeleteVideo接口删除媒体集中的一个视频的信息

DeleteVideoTask.description_en: Deletes a video task by calling the DeleteVideoTask operation
DeleteVideoTask.description_zh: 调用DeleteVideoTask接口删除一个视频任务

DetectImageBodies.description_en: Detects human body information in an image
DetectImageBodies.description_zh: 检测图片中的人体信息

DetectImageFaces.description_en: Calls the DetectImageFaces operation to detect faces and face information in an image
DetectImageFaces.description_zh: 调用DetectImageFaces接口检测图片中的人脸及人脸信息

DetectImageQRCodes.description_en: Detects the positions and content of QR codes in an image
DetectImageQRCodes.description_zh: 检测图片中二维码的位置和内容

DetectImageTags.description_en: Detects label information in an image
DetectImageTags.description_zh: 检测图片中的标签信息

DetectQRCodes.description_en: Detects QR codes in images. We recommend that you use DetectImageQRCodes instead

EncodeBlindWatermark.description_en: The watermark cannot be directly seen in the image, but it can be recovered from the image by using DecodeBlindWatermark
EncodeBlindWatermark.description_zh: 在图片中不能直接看到该水印，但可以通过DecodeBlindWatermark恢复图中隐藏的水印

FindImages.description_en: Searches for images in a media set based on specified conditions, such as time, location, tags, and facial features. The results can be sorted based on specified requirements
FindImages.description_zh: 调用FindImages接口根据指定条件，例如时间、地点、标签、人物特征等，搜索媒体集中图片。并可以按照给定要求进行排序

FindSimilarFaces.description_en: Searches for the top N images most similar to a specified image or face ID from a media set, and returns the corresponding face IDs and bounding boxes. The results are sorted by similarity in descending order
FindSimilarFaces.description_zh: 从媒体集中搜索与指定图片或人脸ID最相似的前N张图片，并返回相应人脸ID及边界框，返回结果按照相似度降序排列

GetImage.description_en: Calls the GetImage operation to get image information from a media set
GetImage.description_zh: 调用GetImage接口从媒体集中获取一张图片的信息

GetImageQuality.description_en: Retrieves the quality score of an image

GetMediaMeta.description_en: Retrieves multimedia file information, such as encoding, bitrate, resolution, and stream details
GetMediaMeta.description_zh: 获取多媒体文件信息，如编码、码率、分辨率、流信息等

GetOfficeConversionTask.description_en: Queries the status of an asynchronous document format conversion task by calling the GetOfficeConversionTask operation
GetOfficeConversionTask.description_zh: 调用GetOfficeConversionTask接口查询异步文档格式转换任务的状态信息

GetOfficePreviewURL.description_en: Retrieves the URL and AccessToken for document preview

GetProject.description_en: Calls the GetProject operation to retrieve information about a project
GetProject.description_zh: 调用GetProject接口获取项目的信息

GetSet.description_en: Calls the GetSet operation to retrieve media set information
GetSet.description_zh: 调用GetSet接口获取媒体集信息

GetVideo.description_en: Retrieves information about a video in a media set by calling GetVideo
GetVideo.description_zh: 调用GetVideo获取媒体集中一个视频的信息

GetVideoTask.description_en: Queries the execution status and result of a video task by calling the GetVideoTask operation
GetVideoTask.description_zh: 调用GetVideoTask接口查询视频任务的执行状态和结果

GetWebofficeURL.description_en: Retrieves access credentials for Weboffice. Weboffice provides online document collaboration features, including preview, editing, and collaboration
GetWebofficeURL.description_zh: 获取Weboffice的访问凭证。Weboffice提供文档的在线协作功能，包括预览、编辑、协作等

IndexImage.description_en: Adds an image to a media set and performs AI detection
IndexImage.description_zh: 将图片加入媒体集，并进行AI检测

IndexVideo.description_en: Calls the IndexVideo operation to add a video to a media set and automatically perform frame extraction, grouping, and recognition on the video
IndexVideo.description_zh: 调用IndexVideo接口将视频添加到媒体集中，并对视频进行自动截帧、分组、识别等操作

ListFaceGroups.description_en: Calls the ListFaceGroups operation to retrieve the list of face groups in a media set
ListFaceGroups.description_zh: 调用ListFaceGroups接口获取一个媒体集中的人脸分组列表

ListImages.description_en: Lists images in a media set. The results are sorted in ascending order by the time when the images were added to the media set
ListImages.description_zh: 获取媒体集中的图片列表，返回结果以图片加入媒体集的时间升序排序

ListOfficeConversionTask.description_en: Lists document format conversion tasks that have been created in a project by calling the ListOfficeConversionTask operation
ListOfficeConversionTask.description_zh: 调用ListOfficeConversionTask接口列出项目中已创建的文档格式转换任务

ListProjects.description_en: Lists information about all created projects by calling the ListProjects operation
ListProjects.description_zh: 调用ListProjects接口列出已创建的所有项目信息

ListSetTags.description_en: Retrieves the top 100 labels in a media set. The results are sorted in descending order by label occurrence count
ListSetTags.description_zh: 获取媒体集中Top 100的标签信息列表，返回结果按标签出现次数降序排列

ListSets.description_en: Calls the ListSets operation to retrieve a list of media sets
ListSets.description_zh: 调用ListSets接口获取媒体集列表

ListVideoTasks.description_en: Lists video task information by calling the ListVideoTasks operation
ListVideoTasks.description_zh: 调用ListVideoTasks接口列出视频任务信息

ListVideos.description_en: Calls the ListVideos operation to retrieve a list of video information from a media set. The results are sorted in ascending order by the time when the videos were added to the media set
ListVideos.description_zh: 调用ListVideos接口获取媒体集中的视频信息列表，返回结果以视频加入媒体集的时间升序排序

OpenImmService.description_en: Calls the OpenImmService operation to activate Intelligent Media Management
OpenImmService.description_zh: 调用OpenImmService接口开通智能媒体管理服务

PutProject.description_en: Creates a project. You can create document standard, image standard, and video standard projects. Create a project based on the content type that you want to process
PutProject.description_zh: 目前支持创建文档标准型、图片标准型和视频标准型项目，请根据需要处理的内容类型创建相应项目

RefreshOfficePreviewToken.description_en: Refreshes the AccessToken credential for document preview

RefreshWebofficeToken.description_en: Refreshes the access credential for Weboffice by calling the RefreshWebofficeToken operation
RefreshWebofficeToken.description_zh: 调用RefreshWebofficeToken接口刷新Weboffice的访问凭证

UpdateFaceGroup.description_en: Updates information about a face group in a media set, such as the name, cover image, and tags
UpdateFaceGroup.description_zh: 更新媒体集中人脸分组的名称、封面图、标签等信息

UpdateImage.description_en: Updates custom image information in a media set by calling the UpdateImage operation
UpdateImage.description_zh: 调用UpdateImage接口更新媒体集中用户自定义的图片信息

UpdateProject.description_en: Calls the UpdateProject operation to update the CU or service role information of a project
UpdateProject.description_zh: 调用UpdateProject接口更新项目的CU或服务角色信息

UpdateSet.description_en: Calls the UpdateSet operation to update the display name of a media set
UpdateSet.description_zh: 调用UpdateSet接口更新媒体集的显示名称
